### ITERATION 1 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Report only patient-explicitly stated impacts on daily activities; do not infer limitations based on profession alone.
[A]: Limit diagnoses and differential diagnoses to those explicitly stated or confirmed by the doctor. Do not infer specific conditions or link unrelated past medical history to the current differential unless explicitly stated by the doctor.
[P]: Ground all plan items in the doctor's explicit recommendations. Include items the doctor proposes, even if their stated rationale for the recommendation is based on a misinterpretation of patient input.

### ITERATION 2 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Report only patient-explicitly stated impacts on daily activities; do not infer limitations based on profession alone. Demographic details (e.g., age, explicit gender) must be explicitly stated in the transcript.
[O]: For telemedicine consultations, explicitly state that no physical examination was performed. Only include objective findings explicitly stated or observed by the doctor; patient-reported symptoms are subjective.
[A]: Limit diagnoses, differential diagnoses, and inferred connections between symptoms or etiologies to those explicitly stated or confirmed by the doctor. Only include explicit statements from the doctor regarding the relevance or irrelevance of past medical history to the current presentation.
[P]: Ground all plan items in the doctor's explicit recommendations. Include items the doctor proposes, even if their stated rationale for the recommendation is based on a misinterpretation of patient input.

### ITERATION 3 CONSTRAINTS
[S]: Report only patient-explicitly stated impacts on daily activities; do not infer limitations based on profession alone. Omit any demographic details (e.g., age, explicit gender) not explicitly stated in the transcript.
[O]: For telemedicine consultations, explicitly state that no physical examination was performed. Only include objective findings explicitly stated or observed by the doctor; patient-reported symptoms are subjective.
[A]: Strictly ground all diagnoses, differential diagnoses, and statements regarding the relevance or irrelevance of past medical history or symptom etiologies to *only* what the doctor explicitly states or confirms. Do not infer or speculate on clinical assessments.
[P]: Ground all plan items in the doctor's explicit recommendations. Include items the doctor proposes, even if their stated rationale for the recommendation is based on a misinterpretation of patient input.
